scope.summary: Implement placed_asset non-destructive accumulated transforms with reset-transforms; unpack back into component layers in place (convert-to-layers); export embedded source back to a standalone file in its original format (export-contents touchpoint to 14.13); statistical stack rendering (mean, median, maximum, range and the other stack modes) over a multi-layer container for noise reduction/analysis; and a 'collect linked assets into one portable folder' (package) command as a document-portability touchpoint per [GLOBAL-PORTABILITY].
acceptance_criteria: statistical stack modes render; package produces a relocatable folder
expected_tests: live: apply then reset transforms; convert-to-layers unpacks a placed_asset into its component layers; export-contents writes original format to disk (Handshake-managed path)
live: statistical stack render (median) reduces noise across a multi-layer container; package collects linked assets into one portable folder

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Stack modes, convert to layers & packaging

risk_if_missed: No stack-mode noise reduction, no unpack/export-contents, no portable packaging of linked assets.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
